summary: RenX Enterprises (Nasdaq: RENX) disclosed that on September 30, 2026 it entered an exchange agreement with James D. Burnham, its Director of Growth M&A and a former board member, to retire $1,446,774.32 of principal and accrued interest under a June 2, 2025 promissory note. Burnham received 1,441 shares of newly designated Series D Convertible Preferred Stock, convertible at $2.895 into 497,754 common shares, plus a warrant for 124,438 shares at $2.895. The debt was cancelled; no advisor or board recommendation named. The exchange is capped by Nasdaq's 19.99% shareholder-approval limit, carries beneficial-ownership blockers, and includes a delisting backstop converting preferred back into a 10% unsecured 24-month note. Watch for shareholder ratification and potential dilution/overhang.
